segments.tr: صواب/خطأ: يجب على المزارع الذي ينتج قرع الزينة لسوق ديكور الهالوين بشكل عام أن يزرع بكثافة أعلى من ذلك الذي ينمي قرع للحشو المعلب.**

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 شروط اليوم

segments.src: - **Direct seeding** — sowing seed straight into the field where the crop will grow to maturity, with no nursery stage.
segments.tr: - **البذر المباشر** — بذر البذرة مباشرة في الحقل حيث ستنمو المحصول حتى النضج، بدون مرحلة مشتل.

segments.src: - **Transplanting** — moving a plant started elsewhere (greenhouse, nursery bed) into its final field position.
segments.tr: - **الزراعة بالشتل** — نقل نبات تم بدؤه في مكان آخر (بيت زجاجي، سرير مشتل) إلى موقعه الميداني النهائي.

segments.src: - **Nursery raising (seedling production)** — growing young plants under controlled conditions before field setting, to gain season length and uniformity.
segments.tr: - **تربية المشتل (إنتاج الشتلات)** — تنمية النباتات الصغيرة في ظروف مضبوطة قبل إعدادها في الحقل، لاكتساب طول الموسم والتوحيد.

segments.src: - **Hardening off** — gradually acclimating protected seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and sun so they survive transplanting with less shock.
segments.tr: - **تقسية الشتلات** — تعويد الشتلات المحمية تدريجياً على البرد والرياح والشمس في الهواء الطلق لتتمكن من البقاء على قيد الحياة عند زراعتها بالشتل بصدمة أقل.

segments.src: - **Planting density (plant population)** — the number of plants per unit area, usually stated as plants per acre.
segments.tr: - **كثافة الزراعة (عدد السكان النباتي)** — عدد النباتات لكل وحدة مساحة، عادة ما يتم ذكره كنباتات لكل فدان.

segments.src: - **Transplant shock** — the temporary growth setback a plant suffers from root disturbance and environmental change during transplanting.
segments.tr: - **صدمة الزراعة بالشتل** — تراجع النمو المؤقت الذي يعاني منه النبات من إزعاج الجذور والتغير البيئي أثناء الزراعة بالشتل.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** Yield per plant declines from the very first added competitor, because each plant gets a smaller share of light, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: *الإجابات: **1 — ب.** ينخفض محصول كل نبات من أول منافس مضاف، لأن كل نبات يحصل على حصة أصغر من الضوء والماء والمغذيات.

segments.src: Yield per acre is the curve that rises then falls; the two are often confused.
segments.tr: محصول الفدان هو المنحنى الذي يرتفع ثم ينخفض؛ غالباً ما يتم الخلط بينهما.

segments.src: **2 — C.** Greenhouse seedlings are soft and unacclimated; a week of gradual outdoor exposure thickens cuticles and toughens tissue so the move doesn't set them back.
segments.tr: **2 — ج.** شتلات بيت زجاجي ناعمة وغير مقسة؛ أسبوع من التعريض الخارجي التدريجي يثخن الطبقة الشمعية وينسج الأنسجة لذلك الانتقال لا يعيدها للخلف.

segments.src: **3 — X (false).** It's the reverse.
segments.tr: **3 — خطأ (خطأ).** إنه العكس.

segments.src: Decorative pumpkins are sold by the unit and big fruit sells better, so they get more room per plant.
segments.tr: قرع الزينة يُباع بالوحدة والثمار الكبيرة تُباع بشكل أفضل، لذا يحصل على مساحة أكثر لكل نبات.

segments.src: Processing pumpkins are sold by weight to the cannery, where total tonnage per acre is all that matters, so they're planted more densely.*
segments.tr: قرع المعالجة يُباع بالوزن لمعمل التعليب، حيث إجمالي الطنيات لكل فدان هو كل ما يهم، لذا يُزرع بكثافة أكبر.*

fr.title: [Agriculture 101 #6] Pourquoi les Agriculteurs se Battent pour Six Pouces de Terre

segments.src: > Growing a crop starts with three decisions — how you start the seed, whether you move the plant, and how tightly you pack the field — and those three choices set the ceiling on your harvest before the plant grows a single leaf.
segments.tr: > Cultiver une récolte commence par trois décisions — comment vous démarrez la graine, si vous déplacez la plante, et comment vous tassez le champ — et ces trois choix établissent le plafond de votre récolte avant que la plante ne pousse une seule feuille.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Le Concept d'Aujourd'hui

segments.src: Every crop production system begins with the same question: **how do we get a plant from a seed into the ground, and how many of them do we want per acre?**
segments.tr: Chaque système de production de récolte commence par la même question : **comment faire passer une plante d'une graine au sol, et combien en voulons-nous par acre ?**

segments.src: There are two basic routes.
segments.tr: Il y a deux voies de base.

segments.src: **Direct seeding** means the seed goes straight into the field where the plant will finish its life.
segments.tr: **Le semis direct** signifie que la graine va directement dans le champ où la plante terminera sa vie.

segments.src: Corn, soybeans, wheat, and carrots are almost always direct seeded.
segments.tr: Le maïs, le soja, le blé et les carottes sont presque toujours semés directement.

segments.src: It's cheap and fast — a planter can cover 40 acres an hour — but the seed is on its own out there, exposed to cold soil, crusting, birds, and weeds that germinate at the same time.
segments.tr: C'est bon marché et rapide — un planteur peut couvrir 40 acres par heure — mais la graine est seule là-bas, exposée aux sols froids, à la croûte, aux oiseaux et aux mauvaises herbes qui germent en même temps.

segments.src: **Transplanting** means the seed germinates somewhere controlled — a greenhouse tray, a nursery bed — and the young plant is moved into the field later.
segments.tr: **Le repiquage** signifie que la graine germe quelque part de contrôlé — un plateau de serre, un lit de pépinière — et la jeune plante est déplacée dans le champ plus tard.

segments.src: Tomatoes, peppers, broccoli, strawberries, and rice (in much of the world) go this route.
segments.tr: Les tomates, les poivrons, le brocoli, les fraises et le riz (dans une grande partie du monde) suivent cette voie.

segments.src: The controlled stage is called **raising seedlings**, or *nursery raising*.
segments.tr: L'étape contrôlée s'appelle **l'élevage de plants**, ou *l'élevage de pépinière*.

segments.src: It costs far more per plant, but it buys you three things:
segments.tr: Cela coûte beaucoup plus par plante, mais cela vous achète trois choses :

segments.src: 1. **Time.** The seedling grows in a warm greenhouse in March while the field is still frozen. When you set it out in May, it's already five weeks old. In a short-season state like Minnesota, that's the difference between harvesting and not.
segments.tr: 1. **Temps.** Le plant pousse dans une serre chaude en mars tandis que le champ est encore gelé. Quand vous le mettez en mai, il a déjà cinq semaines. Dans un état de courte saison comme le Minnesota, c'est la différence entre récolter ou non.

segments.src: 2. **Uniformity.** You throw away the weak seedlings before they ever occupy field space. A direct-seeded field carries its runts all season.
segments.tr: 2. **Uniformité.** Vous jetez les plants faibles avant qu'ils n'occupent jamais l'espace du champ. Un champ semé directement porte ses chétifs toute la saison.

segments.src: 3. **A head start on weeds.** A four-week-old transplant shades out weed seedlings that a germinating direct-seeded crop would lose to.
segments.tr: 3. **Une longueur d'avance sur les mauvaises herbes.** Un repiquage de quatre semaines ombrage les plants de mauvaises herbes qu'une récolte semée directement et en germination perdrait.

segments.src: The cost is **transplant shock** — roots get disturbed, the plant sulks for a few days.
segments.tr: Le coût est le **choc de transplantation** — les racines sont dérangées, la plante boude pendant quelques jours.

segments.src: The standard fix is **hardening off**: a week or so of gradually exposing seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and full sun so they toughen up before the move.
segments.tr: La solution standard est l'**endurcissement** : environ une semaine d'exposition graduelle des plants au froid, au vent et au plein soleil pour qu'ils durcissent avant le déplacement.

segments.src: Then comes the third decision: **planting density** — how many plants per acre, and how they're arranged.
segments.tr: Vient ensuite la troisième décision : **la densité de plantation** — combien de plantes par acre, et comment elles sont arrangées.

segments.src: This is the one that surprises people.
segments.tr: C'est celui qui surprend les gens.

segments.src: More plants does *not* mean more yield forever.
segments.tr: Plus de plantes ne signifie *pas* plus de rendement pour toujours.

segments.src: As you crowd plants together:
segments.tr: Tandis que vous entassez les plantes ensemble :

segments.src: - **Yield per acre** rises, plateaus, and then falls (lodging, disease, shading).
segments.tr: - **Le rendement par acre** augmente, stagne, puis diminue (versement, maladie, ombrage).

segments.src: - **Yield per individual plant** falls the whole way — steadily, from the very first added plant.
segments.tr: - **Le rendement par plante individuelle** chute tout du long — régulièrement, à partir de la toute première plante ajoutée.

segments.src: Which curve you optimize for depends on what you're selling.
segments.tr: La courbe que vous optimisez dépend de ce que vous vendez.

segments.src: If you sell by the ton — corn silage, hay, processing tomatoes — push density high and don't care that each plant is smaller.
segments.tr: Si vous vendez à la tonne — l'ensilage de maïs, le foin, les tomates de transformation — poussez la densité élevée et ne vous souciez pas que chaque plante soit plus petite.

segments.src: If you sell by the unit and size matters — a head of cabbage, a jack-o'-lantern pumpkin, a table-grade apple — back off, because a field of undersized product is worth less than a field of fewer good ones.
segments.tr: Si vous vendez à l'unité et que la taille importe — une tête de chou, une citrouille jack-o'-lantern, une pomme de qualité table — reculez, car un champ de produits sous-dimensionnés vaut moins qu'un champ de moins bons.

segments.src: The arrangement matters too, not just the count.
segments.tr: L'arrangement compte aussi, pas seulement le compte.

segments.src: The same 30,000 plants per acre can sit in 30-inch rows or 15-inch rows.
segments.tr: Les mêmes 30 000 plantes par acre peuvent être disposées en rangées de 30 pouces ou de 15 pouces.

segments.src: Narrower rows spread plants into a more even, square-ish spacing, so each one competes less with its immediate neighbors and the canopy closes over the soil sooner — which shades out weeds and keeps moisture in.
segments.tr: Les rangées plus étroites étalent les plantes dans un espacement plus régulier et carré, de sorte que chacune concurrence moins avec ses voisins immédiats et le couvert se ferme plus tôt sur le sol — ce qui ombrage les mauvaises herbes et maintient l'humidité.

segments.src: That's a big part of why US corn row spacing narrowed over the last century, alongside breeding for plants that tolerate crowding.
segments.tr: C'est une grande partie de la raison pour laquelle l'espacement des rangées de maïs américain s'est resserré au cours du siècle dernier, parallèlement à l'élevage de plantes qui tolèrent l'encombrement.

segments.src: Rough shape of the relationship, in plain text:
segments.tr: Forme approximative de la relation, en texte brut :

segments.src: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)
segments.tr: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)

segments.src: So 30-inch rows (2.5 ft) with plants 7 inches apart in the row (0.583 ft) gives about 43,560 / 1.458 ≈ 29,900 plants per acre.
segments.tr: Donc, les rangées de 30 pouces (2,5 pi) avec des plantes espacées de 7 pouces dans la rangée (0,583 pi) donnent environ 43 560 / 1,458 ≈ 29 900 plantes par acre.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dans la Vie Quotidienne

segments.src: Walk through a garden center in Ohio in late April and you're looking at the whole lesson on two tables.
segments.tr: Promenez-vous dans un centre de jardinage en Ohio à la fin avril et vous regardez toute la leçon sur deux tables.

segments.src: On one table: seed packets.
segments.tr: Sur une table : des paquets de graines.

segments.src: Beans, sweet corn, radishes, carrots — $2 to $4 a packet, dozens of seeds each.
segments.tr: Des haricots, du maïs sucré, des radis, des carottes — 2 $ à 4 $ par paquet, des douzaines de graines chacun.

segments.src: These are the direct-seed crops.
segments.tr: Ce sont les cultures de semis directs.

segments.src: The packet says "sow directly outdoors after last frost" because these plants either grow fast enough not to need a head start (radishes, 25 days) or hate having their roots disturbed (carrots, beans).
segments.tr: Le paquet dit « semer directement à l'extérieur après la dernière gelée » car ces plantes poussent soit assez rapidement pour ne pas avoir besoin d'une longueur d'avance (radis, 25 jours), soit elles détestent avoir les racines dérangées (carottes, haricots).

segments.src: On the other table: cell packs of tomato and pepper starts, $4 to $6 for a four-pack.
segments.tr: Sur l'autre table : des cellules de plants de tomate et de poivron, 4 $ à 6 $ pour un pack de quatre.

segments.src: Nobody sells tomato seed packets to casual buyers with a straight face in Ohio, because a tomato seeded outdoors in May in Columbus won't ripen before the first fall frost.
segments.tr: Personne ne vend de paquets de graines de tomate aux acheteurs occasionnels sans rire en Ohio, car une tomate semée à l'extérieur en mai à Columbus ne mûrira pas avant la première gelée d'automne.

segments.src: Somebody already did the nursery-raising work in February in a heated greenhouse — that's what you're paying for, and it's why a single tomato plant costs more than an entire packet of bean seed.
segments.tr: Quelqu'un a déjà fait le travail d'élevage de pépinière en février dans une serre chauffée — c'est ce que vous payez, et c'est pourquoi une seule plante de tomate coûte plus qu'un paquet entier de graines de haricot.

segments.src: Now the density part.
segments.tr: Maintenant, la partie densité.

segments.src: Flip over that tomato tag: "space 24-36 inches apart."
segments.tr: Retournez cette étiquette de tomate : « espacement 24-36 pouces d'intervalle. »

segments.src: Most first-time gardeners ignore it and plant six tomatoes in a 4x4 raised bed, because the transplants look tiny and the bed looks empty.
segments.tr: La plupart des jardiniers novices l'ignorent et plantent six tomates dans un lit surélevé de 4x4, car les repiquages semblent minuscules et le lit semble vide.

segments.src: By August they've got a tangled mat with poor air circulation, more disease, and small fruit — a personal-scale demonstration of the yield-per-plant curve.
segments.tr: En août, ils ont un tapis enchevêtré avec une mauvaise circulation de l'air, plus de maladie et des fruits petits — une démonstration à l'échelle personnelle de la courbe de rendement par plante.

segments.src: The commercial grower down the road faces the identical tradeoff, just with a spreadsheet: a processing tomato field headed for a cannery gets crowded hard, because the plant is selling by the ton.
segments.tr: L'exploitant agricole commercial plus bas fait face au même dilemme, juste avec une feuille de calcul : un champ de tomates de transformation destiné à une conserverie est très encombré, car la plante se vend à la tonne.

segments.src: A fresh-market field where big, blemish-free fruit brings a premium at the farmers market in Athens gets more room per plant.
segments.tr: Un champ du marché frais où les gros fruits sans défaut apportent une prime au marché fermier à Athènes obtient plus d'espace par plante.

segments.src: Same crop.
segments.tr: Même culture.

segments.src: Different market.
segments.tr: Marché différent.

segments.src: Different correct density.
segments.tr: Densité correcte différente.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Résumé en Trois Lignes

segments.src: 1. Direct seeding puts seed straight in the field — cheap and fast; transplanting raises seedlings in a controlled nursery first — expensive, but it buys season length, uniformity, and a weed head start.
segments.tr: 1. Le semis direct met la graine directement dans le champ — bon marché et rapide ; le repiquage élève d'abord les plants dans une pépinière contrôlée — coûteux, mais cela achète la longueur de la saison, l'uniformité et une longueur d'avance sur les mauvaises herbes.

segments.src: 2. As planting density rises, yield per acre goes up then eventually down, while yield per individual plant declines the entire time — so the right density depends on whether your market pays by weight or by the size of each unit.
segments.tr: 2. À mesure que la densité de plantation augmente, le rendement par acre monte puis finalement baisse, tandis que le rendement par plante individuelle diminue tout le temps — donc la bonne densité dépend de si votre marché paie au poids ou à la taille de chaque unité.

segments.src: 3. Arrangement matters alongside count: narrower rows spread the same plant population more evenly, reducing crowding between neighbors and closing the canopy sooner.
segments.tr: 3. L'arrangement compte aux côtés du compte : les rangées plus étroites étalent la même population de plantes plus régulièrement, réduisant l'encombrement entre les voisins et fermant le couvert plus tôt.

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 Termes d'Aujourd'hui

segments.src: - **Direct seeding** — sowing seed straight into the field where the crop will grow to maturity, with no nursery stage.
segments.tr: - **Semis direct** — semer la graine directement dans le champ où la récolte poussera à maturité, sans étape de pépinière.

segments.src: - **Transplanting** — moving a plant started elsewhere (greenhouse, nursery bed) into its final field position.
segments.tr: - **Repiquage** — déplacer une plante commencée ailleurs (serre, lit de pépinière) dans sa position finale du champ.

segments.src: - **Nursery raising (seedling production)** — growing young plants under controlled conditions before field setting, to gain season length and uniformity.
segments.tr: - **Élevage de pépinière (production de plants)** — cultiver de jeunes plantes dans des conditions contrôlées avant la plantation au champ, pour gagner en longueur de saison et uniformité.

segments.src: - **Hardening off** — gradually acclimating protected seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and sun so they survive transplanting with less shock.
segments.tr: - **Endurcissement** — acclimater progressivement les plants protégés au froid, au vent et au soleil extérieurs afin qu'ils survivent au repiquage avec moins de choc.

segments.src: - **Planting density (plant population)** — the number of plants per unit area, usually stated as plants per acre.
segments.tr: - **Densité de plantation (population de plantes)** — le nombre de plantes par unité de surface, généralement exprimé en plantes par acre.

segments.src: - **Transplant shock** — the temporary growth setback a plant suffers from root disturbance and environmental change during transplanting.
segments.tr: - **Choc de transplantation** — l'arrêt de croissance temporaire qu'une plante subit en raison du dérangement des racines et du changement environnemental lors du repiquage.

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** Yield per plant declines from the very first added competitor, because each plant gets a smaller share of light, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: *Réponses : **1 — B.** Le rendement par plante diminue à partir du tout premier concurrent ajouté, car chaque plante obtient une plus petite part de lumière, d'eau et de nutriments.

segments.src: Yield per acre is the curve that rises then falls; the two are often confused.
segments.tr: Le rendement par acre est la courbe qui augmente puis diminue ; les deux sont souvent confondus.

segments.src: **2 — C.** Greenhouse seedlings are soft and unacclimated; a week of gradual outdoor exposure thickens cuticles and toughens tissue so the move doesn't set them back.
segments.tr: **2 — C.** Les plants de serre sont mous et non acclimatés ; une semaine d'exposition graduelle à l'extérieur épaissit les cuticules et renforce le tissu pour que le déplacement ne les retarde pas.

segments.src: **3 — X (false).** It's the reverse.
segments.tr: **3 — X (faux).** C'est l'inverse.

segments.src: Decorative pumpkins are sold by the unit and big fruit sells better, so they get more room per plant.
segments.tr: Les citrouilles décoratives sont vendues à l'unité et les gros fruits se vendent mieux, donc elles obtiennent plus d'espace par plante.

segments.src: Processing pumpkins are sold by weight to the cannery, where total tonnage per acre is all that matters, so they're planted more densely.*
segments.tr: Les citrouilles de transformation sont vendues au poids à la conserverie, où le tonnage total par acre est tout ce qui compte, donc elles sont plantées plus densément.*

pt.title: [Agriculture 101 #6] Por Que Agricultores Disputam Seis Polegadas de Terra

segments.src: > Growing a crop starts with three decisions — how you start the seed, whether you move the plant, and how tightly you pack the field — and those three choices set the ceiling on your harvest before the plant grows a single leaf.
segments.tr: > Cultivar uma safra começa com três decisões — como você inicia a semente, se move a planta ou não, e quão bem você preenche o campo — e essas três escolhas estabelecem o teto da sua colheita antes de a planta crescer uma única folha.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Conceito de Hoje

segments.src: Every crop production system begins with the same question: **how do we get a plant from a seed into the ground, and how many of them do we want per acre?**
segments.tr: Todo sistema de produção de culturas começa com a mesma pergunta: **como fazemos uma planta sair de uma semente para o solo, e quantas delas queremos por acre?**

segments.src: There are two basic routes.
segments.tr: Existem duas rotas básicas.

segments.src: **Direct seeding** means the seed goes straight into the field where the plant will finish its life.
segments.tr: **Plantio direto** significa que a semente vai diretamente para o campo onde a planta terminará sua vida.

segments.src: Corn, soybeans, wheat, and carrots are almost always direct seeded.
segments.tr: Milho, soja, trigo e cenoura são quase sempre plantados diretamente.

segments.src: It's cheap and fast — a planter can cover 40 acres an hour — but the seed is on its own out there, exposed to cold soil, crusting, birds, and weeds that germinate at the same time.
segments.tr: É barato e rápido — uma semeadora pode cobrir 40 acres por hora — mas a semente fica sozinha lá, exposta a solo frio, formação de crosta, pássaros e ervas daninhas que germinam ao mesmo tempo.

segments.src: **Transplanting** means the seed germinates somewhere controlled — a greenhouse tray, a nursery bed — and the young plant is moved into the field later.
segments.tr: **Transplantio** significa que a semente germina em algum lugar controlado — uma bandeja de estufa, um canteiro de viveiro — e a planta jovem é movida para o campo mais tarde.

segments.src: Tomatoes, peppers, broccoli, strawberries, and rice (in much of the world) go this route.
segments.tr: Tomates, pimentões, brócolis, morangos e arroz (em grande parte do mundo) seguem esse caminho.

segments.src: The controlled stage is called **raising seedlings**, or *nursery raising*.
segments.tr: O estágio controlado é chamado de **cultivo de mudas**, ou *cultivo em viveiro*.

segments.src: It costs far more per plant, but it buys you three things:
segments.tr: Custa muito mais por planta, mas oferece três coisas:

segments.src: 1. **Time.** The seedling grows in a warm greenhouse in March while the field is still frozen. When you set it out in May, it's already five weeks old. In a short-season state like Minnesota, that's the difference between harvesting and not.
segments.tr: 1. **Tempo.** A muda cresce em uma estufa quente em março enquanto o campo ainda está congelado. Quando você a coloca em maio, ela já tem cinco semanas de idade. Em um estado com estação curta como Minnesota, essa é a diferença entre colher e não colher.

segments.src: 2. **Uniformity.** You throw away the weak seedlings before they ever occupy field space. A direct-seeded field carries its runts all season.
segments.tr: 2. **Uniformidade.** Você joga fora as mudas fracas antes de elas ocuparem espaço no campo. Um campo com plantio direto carrega seus pequeninos o tempo todo.

segments.src: 3. **A head start on weeds.** A four-week-old transplant shades out weed seedlings that a germinating direct-seeded crop would lose to.
segments.tr: 3. **Vantagem sobre as ervas daninhas.** Um transplante com quatro semanas sombreia as mudas de ervas daninhas que uma safra germinada com plantio direto perderia para.

segments.src: The cost is **transplant shock** — roots get disturbed, the plant sulks for a few days.
segments.tr: O custo é o **choque do transplante** — as raízes são perturbadas, a planta fica desanimada por alguns dias.

segments.src: The standard fix is **hardening off**: a week or so of gradually exposing seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and full sun so they toughen up before the move.
segments.tr: A solução padrão é **endurecimento**: cerca de uma semana de exposição gradual das mudas ao frio, vento e sol cheio ao ar livre para que se fortaleçam antes da mudança.

segments.src: Then comes the third decision: **planting density** — how many plants per acre, and how they're arranged.
segments.tr: Depois vem a terceira decisão: **densidade de plantio** — quantas plantas por acre, e como elas são arranjadas.

segments.src: This is the one that surprises people.
segments.tr: Esta é a que surpreende as pessoas.

segments.src: More plants does *not* mean more yield forever.
segments.tr: Mais plantas *não* significam mais produção para sempre.

segments.src: As you crowd plants together:
segments.tr: Conforme você aproxima as plantas:

segments.src: - **Yield per acre** rises, plateaus, and then falls (lodging, disease, shading).
segments.tr: - **Produção por acre** sobe, se estabiliza e depois cai (acamamento, doença, sombreamento).

segments.src: - **Yield per individual plant** falls the whole way — steadily, from the very first added plant.
segments.tr: - **Produção por planta individual** cai o tempo todo — constantemente, da primeira planta adicionada em diante.

segments.src: Which curve you optimize for depends on what you're selling.
segments.tr: Qual curva você otimiza depende do que você está vendendo.

segments.src: If you sell by the ton — corn silage, hay, processing tomatoes — push density high and don't care that each plant is smaller.
segments.tr: Se você vende por tonelada — silagem de milho, feno, tomates para processamento — aumente a densidade e não se preocupe que cada planta é menor.

segments.src: If you sell by the unit and size matters — a head of cabbage, a jack-o'-lantern pumpkin, a table-grade apple — back off, because a field of undersized product is worth less than a field of fewer good ones.
segments.tr: Se você vende por unidade e o tamanho importa — uma cabeça de repolho, uma abóbora para jack-o'-lantern, uma maçã de grau de mesa — recue, porque um campo de produto de tamanho menor vale menos que um campo com menos unidades boas.

segments.src: The arrangement matters too, not just the count.
segments.tr: O arranjo também importa, não apenas a contagem.

segments.src: The same 30,000 plants per acre can sit in 30-inch rows or 15-inch rows.
segments.tr: As mesmas 30.000 plantas por acre podem estar em fileiras de 30 polegadas ou em fileiras de 15 polegadas.

segments.src: Narrower rows spread plants into a more even, square-ish spacing, so each one competes less with its immediate neighbors and the canopy closes over the soil sooner — which shades out weeds and keeps moisture in.
segments.tr: Fileiras mais estreitas distribuem as plantas em um espaçamento mais uniforme e quadrado, então cada uma compete menos com seus vizinhos imediatos e o dossel fecha sobre o solo mais cedo — o que sombreia as ervas daninhas e mantém a umidade.

segments.src: That's a big part of why US corn row spacing narrowed over the last century, alongside breeding for plants that tolerate crowding.
segments.tr: Essa é uma grande parte da razão pela qual o espaçamento de fileiras de milho dos EUA se estreitou ao longo do último século, junto com o melhoramento de plantas que toleram aglomeração.

segments.src: Rough shape of the relationship, in plain text:
segments.tr: Forma aproximada da relação, em texto simples:

segments.src: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)
segments.tr: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)

segments.src: So 30-inch rows (2.5 ft) with plants 7 inches apart in the row (0.583 ft) gives about 43,560 / 1.458 ≈ 29,900 plants per acre.
segments.tr: Então fileiras de 30 polegadas (2,5 pés) com plantas 7 polegadas de distância na fileira (0,583 pés) resultam em aproximadamente 43.560 / 1.458 ≈ 29.900 plantas por acre.

in.title: [Pertanian 101 #6] Mengapa Petani Bersengketa atas Enam Inci Tanah

segments.src: > Growing a crop starts with three decisions — how you start the seed, whether you move the plant, and how tightly you pack the field — and those three choices set the ceiling on your harvest before the plant grows a single leaf.
segments.tr: > Menumbuhkan tanaman dimulai dengan tiga keputusan — bagaimana Anda memulai benih, apakah Anda memindahkan tanaman, dan seberapa rapat Anda mengemas ladang — dan ketiga pilihan itu menetapkan batas panen Anda sebelum tanaman tumbuh satu daun pun.

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## Konsep Hari Ini

segments.src: Every crop production system begins with the same question: **how do we get a plant from a seed into the ground, and how many of them do we want per acre?**
segments.tr: Setiap sistem produksi tanaman dimulai dengan pertanyaan yang sama: **bagaimana cara kita mendapatkan tanaman dari benih ke dalam tanah, dan berapa banyak yang ingin kita miliki per acre?**

segments.src: There are two basic routes.
segments.tr: Ada dua rute dasar.

segments.src: **Direct seeding** means the seed goes straight into the field where the plant will finish its life.
segments.tr: **Penyemaian langsung** berarti benih langsung ke ladang tempat tanaman akan menyelesaikan hidupnya.

segments.src: Corn, soybeans, wheat, and carrots are almost always direct seeded.
segments.tr: Jagung, kedelai, gandum, dan wortel hampir selalu disemaikan langsung.

segments.src: It's cheap and fast — a planter can cover 40 acres an hour — but the seed is on its own out there, exposed to cold soil, crusting, birds, and weeds that germinate at the same time.
segments.tr: Ini murah dan cepat — penanam dapat mencakup 40 acre per jam — tetapi benih itu sendirian di luar sana, terbuka terhadap tanah dingin, pembentukan kerak, burung, dan gulma yang berkecambah pada waktu yang sama.

segments.src: **Transplanting** means the seed germinates somewhere controlled — a greenhouse tray, a nursery bed — and the young plant is moved into the field later.
segments.tr: **Transplantasi** berarti benih berkecambah di tempat yang terkontrol — baki rumah kaca, tempat tidur pembibitan — dan tanaman muda dipindahkan ke ladang kemudian.

segments.src: Tomatoes, peppers, broccoli, strawberries, and rice (in much of the world) go this route.
segments.tr: Tomat, paprika, brokoli, stroberi, dan beras (di sebagian besar dunia) mengikuti rute ini.

segments.src: The controlled stage is called **raising seedlings**, or *nursery raising*.
segments.tr: Tahap terkontrol disebut **memelihara bibit**, atau *pembibitan*.

segments.src: It costs far more per plant, but it buys you three things:
segments.tr: Ini biaya jauh lebih tinggi per tanaman, tetapi itu memberikan Anda tiga hal:

segments.src: 1. **Time.** The seedling grows in a warm greenhouse in March while the field is still frozen. When you set it out in May, it's already five weeks old. In a short-season state like Minnesota, that's the difference between harvesting and not.
segments.tr: 1. **Waktu.** Bibit tumbuh di rumah kaca yang hangat di Maret sementara ladang masih beku. Ketika Anda mengaturnya di bulan Mei, sudah berusia lima minggu. Di negara musim singkat seperti Minnesota, itu adalah perbedaan antara panen dan tidak.

segments.src: 2. **Uniformity.** You throw away the weak seedlings before they ever occupy field space. A direct-seeded field carries its runts all season.
segments.tr: 2. **Keseragaman.** Anda membuang bibit yang lemah sebelum mereka pernah menempati ruang ladang. Ladang yang disemaikan langsung membawa tanaman terhambat sepanjang musim.

segments.src: 3. **A head start on weeds.** A four-week-old transplant shades out weed seedlings that a germinating direct-seeded crop would lose to.
segments.tr: 3. **Keunggulan awal terhadap gulma.** Transplantasi berusia empat minggu membayangi bibit gulma yang akan hilang dari tanaman yang disemaikan langsung.

segments.src: The cost is **transplant shock** — roots get disturbed, the plant sulks for a few days.
segments.tr: Biayanya adalah **kejut transplantasi** — akar terganggu, tanaman rewel selama beberapa hari.

segments.src: The standard fix is **hardening off**: a week or so of gradually exposing seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and full sun so they toughen up before the move.
segments.tr: Solusi standar adalah **pengerasan**: seminggu atau lebih dari paparan bibit secara bertahap terhadap dingin di luar ruangan, angin, dan sinar matahari penuh sehingga mereka menjadi tangguh sebelum dipindahkan.

segments.src: Then comes the third decision: **planting density** — how many plants per acre, and how they're arranged.
segments.tr: Kemudian datang keputusan ketiga: **kepadatan penanaman** — berapa banyak tanaman per acre, dan bagaimana cara mereka disusun.

segments.src: This is the one that surprises people.
segments.tr: Ini adalah yang mengejutkan orang.

segments.src: More plants does *not* mean more yield forever.
segments.tr: Lebih banyak tanaman *tidak* berarti hasil lebih banyak selamanya.

segments.src: As you crowd plants together:
segments.tr: Saat Anda mengelompokkan tanaman bersama-sama:

segments.src: - **Yield per acre** rises, plateaus, and then falls (lodging, disease, shading).
segments.tr: - **Hasil per acre** naik, mendatar, kemudian turun (rebah, penyakit, bayangan).

segments.src: - **Yield per individual plant** falls the whole way — steadily, from the very first added plant.
segments.tr: - **Hasil per tanaman individual** turun sepanjang jalan — terus-menerus, dari tanaman pertama yang ditambahkan.

segments.src: Which curve you optimize for depends on what you're selling.
segments.tr: Kurva mana yang Anda optimalkan tergantung pada apa yang Anda jual.

segments.src: If you sell by the ton — corn silage, hay, processing tomatoes — push density high and don't care that each plant is smaller.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menjual per ton — silase jagung, jerami, tomat pemrosesan — dorong kepadatan tinggi dan jangan peduli bahwa setiap tanaman lebih kecil.

segments.src: If you sell by the unit and size matters — a head of cabbage, a jack-o'-lantern pumpkin, a table-grade apple — back off, because a field of undersized product is worth less than a field of fewer good ones.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menjual per unit dan ukuran penting — kepala kubis, labu jack-o'-lantern, apel tingkat meja — mundur, karena lapangan produk yang terlalu kecil bernilai lebih rendah daripada lapangan dengan lebih sedikit produk yang baik.

segments.src: The arrangement matters too, not just the count.
segments.tr: Pengaturannya juga penting, bukan hanya jumlahnya.

segments.src: The same 30,000 plants per acre can sit in 30-inch rows or 15-inch rows.
segments.tr: 30.000 tanaman yang sama per acre dapat duduk di baris 30-inci atau baris 15-inci.

segments.src: Narrower rows spread plants into a more even, square-ish spacing, so each one competes less with its immediate neighbors and the canopy closes over the soil sooner — which shades out weeds and keeps moisture in.
segments.tr: Baris yang lebih sempit menyebarkan tanaman ke dalam jarak yang lebih merata, berbentuk persegi, sehingga masing-masing bersaing lebih sedikit dengan tetangga terdekatnya dan kanopi menutup tanah lebih cepat — yang membayangi gulma dan menjaga kelembaban di dalamnya.

segments.src: That's a big part of why US corn row spacing narrowed over the last century, alongside breeding for plants that tolerate crowding.
segments.tr: Itu adalah bagian besar dari mengapa jarak baris jagung AS menyempit selama abad terakhir, bersama dengan pemuliaan tanaman yang toleran terhadap kepadatan.

segments.src: Rough shape of the relationship, in plain text:
segments.tr: Bentuk kasar hubungan, dalam teks biasa:

segments.src: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)
segments.tr: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)

segments.src: So 30-inch rows (2.5 ft) with plants 7 inches apart in the row (0.583 ft) gives about 43,560 / 1.458 ≈ 29,900 plants per acre.
segments.tr: Jadi baris 30-inci (2.5 ft) dengan tanaman berjarak 7 inci di baris (0.583 ft) memberikan sekitar 43,560 / 1.458 ≈ 29,900 tanaman per acre.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Dalam Kehidupan Sehari-hari

segments.src: Walk through a garden center in Ohio in late April and you're looking at the whole lesson on two tables.
segments.tr: Berjalan melalui pusat taman di Ohio di akhir April dan Anda melihat seluruh pelajaran di dua meja.

segments.src: On one table: seed packets.
segments.tr: Di satu meja: paket benih.

segments.src: Beans, sweet corn, radishes, carrots — $2 to $4 a packet, dozens of seeds each.
segments.tr: Kacang, jagung manis, lobak, wortel — $2 hingga $4 per paket, puluhan benih masing-masing.

segments.src: These are the direct-seed crops.
segments.tr: Ini adalah tanaman penyemaian langsung.

segments.src: The packet says "sow directly outdoors after last frost" because these plants either grow fast enough not to need a head start (radishes, 25 days) or hate having their roots disturbed (carrots, beans).
segments.tr: Paket mengatakan "tanam langsung di luar ruangan setelah es terakhir" karena tanaman-tanaman ini tumbuh cukup cepat untuk tidak memerlukan keunggulan awal (lobak, 25 hari) atau membenci akar mereka terganggu (wortel, kacang).

segments.src: On the other table: cell packs of tomato and pepper starts, $4 to $6 for a four-pack.
segments.tr: Di meja lain: paket sel dari awal tomat dan paprika, $4 hingga $6 untuk paket empat sel.

segments.src: Nobody sells tomato seed packets to casual buyers with a straight face in Ohio, because a tomato seeded outdoors in May in Columbus won't ripen before the first fall frost.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang menjual paket benih tomat kepada pembeli santai dengan muka lurus di Ohio, karena tomat yang disemaikan di luar ruangan di bulan Mei di Columbus tidak akan matang sebelum es musim gugur pertama.

segments.src: Somebody already did the nursery-raising work in February in a heated greenhouse — that's what you're paying for, and it's why a single tomato plant costs more than an entire packet of bean seed.
segments.tr: Seseorang sudah melakukan pekerjaan pembibitan di Februari di rumah kaca yang dipanaskan — itulah yang Anda bayar, dan itu mengapa satu tanaman tomat biaya lebih dari seluruh paket benih kacang.

segments.src: Now the density part.
segments.tr: Sekarang bagian kepadatan.

segments.src: Flip over that tomato tag: "space 24-36 inches apart."
segments.tr: Balik label tomat itu: "berjarak 24-36 inci."

segments.src: Most first-time gardeners ignore it and plant six tomatoes in a 4x4 raised bed, because the transplants look tiny and the bed looks empty.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar petani taman pemula mengabaikannya dan menanam enam tomat di tempat tidur yang ditinggikan 4x4, karena transplantasi terlihat kecil dan tempat tidur terlihat kosong.

segments.src: By August they've got a tangled mat with poor air circulation, more disease, and small fruit — a personal-scale demonstration of the yield-per-plant curve.
segments.tr: Pada bulan Agustus mereka memiliki tikar yang kusut dengan sirkulasi udara yang buruk, lebih banyak penyakit, dan buah-buahan kecil — demonstrasi skala pribadi dari kurva hasil per tanaman.

segments.src: The commercial grower down the road faces the identical tradeoff, just with a spreadsheet: a processing tomato field headed for a cannery gets crowded hard, because the plant is selling by the ton.
segments.tr: Petani komersial di jalan menghadapi pertukaran yang identik, hanya dengan spreadsheet: lapangan tomat pemrosesan yang menuju cannery ramai keras, karena tanaman dijual per ton.

segments.src: A fresh-market field where big, blemish-free fruit brings a premium at the farmers market in Athens gets more room per plant.
segments.tr: Lapangan pasar segar di mana buah-buahan besar, bebas cacat membawa premi di pasar petani di Athens mendapat lebih banyak ruang per tanaman.

segments.src: 3. Arrangement matters alongside count: narrower rows spread the same plant population more evenly, reducing crowding between neighbors and closing the canopy sooner.
segments.tr: 3. Pengaturan penting bersama hitungan: baris yang lebih sempit menyebarkan populasi tanaman yang sama lebih merata, mengurangi kepadatan antara tetangga dan menutup kanopi lebih cepat.

segments.src: > Growing a crop starts with three decisions — how you start the seed, whether you move the plant, and how tightly you pack the field — and those three choices set the ceiling on your harvest before the plant grows a single leaf.
segments.tr: > 作物の栽培は3つの決定から始まります。種子をどのように開始するか、植物を移動するかどうか、そして畑に詰める方法です。そしてこれら3つの選択は、植物がまだ1枚の葉も出していないうちに、あなたの収穫の上限を決めてしまいます。

segments.src: ## Today's Concept
segments.tr: ## 本日のコンセプト

segments.src: Every crop production system begins with the same question: **how do we get a plant from a seed into the ground, and how many of them do we want per acre?**
segments.tr: すべての作物生産システムは同じ質問から始まります。**種子から植物を地面に植えるにはどうするか、そして1エーカーあたり何株の植物が必要か？**

segments.src: There are two basic routes.
segments.tr: 2つの基本的な方法があります。

segments.src: **Direct seeding** means the seed goes straight into the field where the plant will finish its life.
segments.tr: **直播き**とは、種子が植物の最終的な生育地である畑に直接播かれることを意味します。

segments.src: Corn, soybeans, wheat, and carrots are almost always direct seeded.
segments.tr: トウモロコシ、大豆、小麦、ニンジンはほぼ常に直播きされます。

segments.src: It's cheap and fast — a planter can cover 40 acres an hour — but the seed is on its own out there, exposed to cold soil, crusting, birds, and weeds that germinate at the same time.
segments.tr: 安くて速い方法です。プランターは1時間に40エーカーをカバーできます。ただし、種子は冷たい土、地盤の形成、鳥、そして同時に発芽する雑草にさらされます。

segments.src: **Transplanting** means the seed germinates somewhere controlled — a greenhouse tray, a nursery bed — and the young plant is moved into the field later.
segments.tr: **移植**とは、種子が管理された環境（温室のトレイやナーセリーベッド）で発芽し、後に若い植物を畑に移動させることです。

segments.src: Tomatoes, peppers, broccoli, strawberries, and rice (in much of the world) go this route.
segments.tr: トマト、ピーマン、ブロッコリー、イチゴ、そして（世界の多くの地域で）米はこのルートで育てられます。

segments.src: The controlled stage is called **raising seedlings**, or *nursery raising*.
segments.tr: この管理された段階は**苗の育成**、または*ナーセリー育成*と呼ばれます。

segments.src: It costs far more per plant, but it buys you three things:
segments.tr: 植物あたりの費用ははるかに高くなりますが、3つの利点が得られます。

segments.src: 1. **Time.** The seedling grows in a warm greenhouse in March while the field is still frozen. When you set it out in May, it's already five weeks old. In a short-season state like Minnesota, that's the difference between harvesting and not.
segments.tr: 1. **時間。** 苗は3月の温かい温室で成長しますが、その間、畑はまだ凍ったままです。5月に定植した時点で、既に5週間前の苗です。ミネソタのような短い生育期の州では、これが収穫できるかできないかの違いになります。

segments.src: 2. **Uniformity.** You throw away the weak seedlings before they ever occupy field space. A direct-seeded field carries its runts all season.
segments.tr: 2. **均一性。** 弱い苗は畑のスペースを占める前に取り除かれます。直播きした畑は、季節を通じて劣った植物を抱えています。

segments.src: 3. **A head start on weeds.** A four-week-old transplant shades out weed seedlings that a germinating direct-seeded crop would lose to.
segments.tr: 3. **雑草への先制。** 4週間の移植苗は、同時に発芽した直播きの作物が失うはずの雑草の苗を抑制します。

segments.src: The cost is **transplant shock** — roots get disturbed, the plant sulks for a few days.
segments.tr: 代価は**移植時の生育遅延**です。根が傷つき、植物は数日間ふくれっ面になります。

segments.src: The standard fix is **hardening off**: a week or so of gradually exposing seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and full sun so they toughen up before the move.
segments.tr: 標準的な対策は**硬化処理**です。1週間程度、苗を徐々に屋外の冷気、風、そして直射日光に慣らすことで、苗が強くなってから移植します。

segments.src: Then comes the third decision: **planting density** — how many plants per acre, and how they're arranged.
segments.tr: 次に3番目の決定が来ます。**植栽密度**です。1エーカーあたり何株の植物を育てるか、そしてどのように配置するかです。

segments.src: This is the one that surprises people.
segments.tr: この点が多くの人を驚かせます。

segments.src: More plants does *not* mean more yield forever.
segments.tr: 植物を増やせば、ずっと収量が増えるわけではありません。

segments.src: As you crowd plants together:
segments.tr: 植物を密集させていくと：

segments.src: - **Yield per acre** rises, plateaus, and then falls (lodging, disease, shading).
segments.tr: - **単位面積あたりの収量**は上昇し、やがてプラトーに達した後、低下します（倒伏、病気、遮光）。

segments.src: - **Yield per individual plant** falls the whole way — steadily, from the very first added plant.
segments.tr: - **1株あたりの収量**は最初に追加した株からずっと低下し続けます。

segments.src: Which curve you optimize for depends on what you're selling.
segments.tr: どの曲線を最適化するかは、何を販売しているかによって異なります。

segments.src: If you sell by the ton — corn silage, hay, processing tomatoes — push density high and don't care that each plant is smaller.
segments.tr: トン単位で販売する場合、つまり、トウモロコシサイレージ、牧草、加工用トマトなら、密度を高く保ち、1株が小さくなることは気にしません。

segments.src: If you sell by the unit and size matters — a head of cabbage, a jack-o'-lantern pumpkin, a table-grade apple — back off, because a field of undersized product is worth less than a field of fewer good ones.
segments.tr: 単位で販売し、サイズが重要な場合、つまりキャベツの玉、ジャック-オー-ランタン用カボチャ、テーブルグレードのリンゴなら、株間を広げます。なぜなら、規格外の製品ばかりの畑は、良質な製品がある畑より価値が低いからです。

segments.src: The arrangement matters too, not just the count.
segments.tr: 配置も重要で、単なる本数の問題ではありません。

segments.src: The same 30,000 plants per acre can sit in 30-inch rows or 15-inch rows.
segments.tr: 1エーカーあたり30,000株の同じ本数でも、30インチ列または15インチ列に植えることができます。

segments.src: Narrower rows spread plants into a more even, square-ish spacing, so each one competes less with its immediate neighbors and the canopy closes over the soil sooner — which shades out weeds and keeps moisture in.
segments.tr: 狭い列間隔は植物をより均等で正方形に近い配置に広げるため、各株は隣同士の競争が少なく、キャノピーが土を早く覆い隠します。これにより雑草を抑制し、土の水分が保持されます。

segments.src: That's a big part of why US corn row spacing narrowed over the last century, alongside breeding for plants that tolerate crowding.
segments.tr: これが過去1世紀にわたって米国のトウモロコシの列間隔が狭まった大きな理由の1つです。同時に、密集栽培に耐える品種の育成も進みました。

segments.src: Rough shape of the relationship, in plain text:
segments.tr: この関係をシンプルなテキストで表すなら：

segments.src: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)
segments.tr: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)

segments.src: So 30-inch rows (2.5 ft) with plants 7 inches apart in the row (0.583 ft) gives about 43,560 / 1.458 ≈ 29,900 plants per acre.
segments.tr: つまり、30インチ列（2.5フィート）で列内の株間が7インチ（0.583フィート）なら、約43,560 / 1.458 ≈ 1エーカーあたり29,900株となります。

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## 日常生活では

segments.src: Walk through a garden center in Ohio in late April and you're looking at the whole lesson on two tables.
segments.tr: 4月下旬にオハイオ州のガーデンセンターを歩き回ると、2つのテーブルにこの全体のレッスンが詰まっています。

segments.src: On one table: seed packets.
segments.tr: 一方のテーブル：種子パケット。

segments.src: Beans, sweet corn, radishes, carrots — $2 to $4 a packet, dozens of seeds each.
segments.tr: 豆、スイートコーン、ラディッシュ、ニンジン。1パケット2～4ドル、それぞれ数十粒の種が入っています。

segments.src: These are the direct-seed crops.
segments.tr: これらは直播きの作物です。

segments.src: The packet says "sow directly outdoors after last frost" because these plants either grow fast enough not to need a head start (radishes, 25 days) or hate having their roots disturbed (carrots, beans).
segments.tr: パケットには「最後の霜の後、屋外に直播きしてください」と書かれています。これらの植物は、前もって育てる必要がないほど速く成長するか（ラディッシュは25日）、根が傷つくのを嫌うかのどちらかです（ニンジン、豆）。

segments.src: On the other table: cell packs of tomato and pepper starts, $4 to $6 for a four-pack.
segments.tr: もう一方のテーブル：トマトとピーマンの苗の入ったセルパック、4株入りで4～6ドル。

segments.src: Nobody sells tomato seed packets to casual buyers with a straight face in Ohio, because a tomato seeded outdoors in May in Columbus won't ripen before the first fall frost.
segments.tr: オハイオ州では、誰も真顔でカジュアルな買い手にトマトの種子パケットを売りません。なぜなら、コロンバスで5月に屋外に播かれたトマトは、秋の最初の霜が来る前に熟さないからです。

segments.src: Somebody already did the nursery-raising work in February in a heated greenhouse — that's what you're paying for, and it's why a single tomato plant costs more than an entire packet of bean seed.
segments.tr: 誰かが既に2月に温かい温室でナーセリー育成の仕事を済ませているのです。それがあなたが支払っている代金です。だからトマトの苗1株は、豆の種のパケット全体より高い値段なのです。

segments.src: Now the density part.
segments.tr: 次に密度について。

segments.src: Flip over that tomato tag: "space 24-36 inches apart."
segments.tr: トマトのラベルを裏返すと：「24～36インチ間隔で植える」と書かれています。

segments.src: Most first-time gardeners ignore it and plant six tomatoes in a 4x4 raised bed, because the transplants look tiny and the bed looks empty.
segments.tr: 初心者のガーデナーの大多数はそれを無視し、4×4フィートの高畦に6株のトマトを植えます。苗は小さく見え、畝が空いているように見えるからです。

segments.src: By August they've got a tangled mat with poor air circulation, more disease, and small fruit — a personal-scale demonstration of the yield-per-plant curve.
segments.tr: 8月までに、彼らは通風が悪い絡み合ったヤブ、より多くの病気、そして小さな実を持つようになります。これは1株あたりの収量曲線を個人的に実証しています。

segments.src: The commercial grower down the road faces the identical tradeoff, just with a spreadsheet: a processing tomato field headed for a cannery gets crowded hard, because the plant is selling by the ton.
segments.tr: 近くの商業生産者は同じトレードオフに直面します。ただしスプレッドシートを使って計算します。缶詰工場に向かう加工用トマト畑は高い密度で植えられます。植物をトン単位で販売するからです。

segments.src: A fresh-market field where big, blemish-free fruit brings a premium at the farmers market in Athens gets more room per plant.
segments.tr: 一方、新鮮市場向けの畑では、アテネのファーマーズマーケットで大きく傷のない実が高値で売れるので、株間をより広くしています。

segments.src: Same crop.
segments.tr: 同じ作物。

segments.src: Different market.
segments.tr: 異なる市場。

segments.src: Different correct density.
segments.tr: 異なる最適な密度。

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## 3行要約

segments.src: 1. Direct seeding puts seed straight in the field — cheap and fast; transplanting raises seedlings in a controlled nursery first — expensive, but it buys season length, uniformity, and a weed head start.
segments.tr: 1. 直播きは種を畑に直接播きます。安くて速いです。一方、移植は最初に管理されたナーセリーで苗を育てます。費用がかかりますが、生育期の延長、株の均一性、そして雑草に対する先制を得られます。

segments.src: 2. As planting density rises, yield per acre goes up then eventually down, while yield per individual plant declines the entire time — so the right density depends on whether your market pays by weight or by the size of each unit.
segments.tr: 2. 植栽密度が上がると、単位面積あたりの収量は上昇しますが、やがて低下します。一方、1株あたりの収量はずっと低下し続けます。したがって、最適な密度は、市場が重量で買い取るか、それとも単位のサイズで買い取るかに依存します。

segments.src: 3. Arrangement matters alongside count: narrower rows spread the same plant population more evenly, reducing crowding between neighbors and closing the canopy sooner.
segments.tr: 3. 配置も本数と同じくらい重要です。狭い列間隔は同じ本数の植物をより均等に分散させ、株同士の競争を減らし、キャノピーが早く土を覆います。

segments.tr: ## ✅ 自己テスト

segments.tr: 植栽密度を上げると、1株あたりの収量はどうなりますか？**

segments.tr: - A) 上昇してから低下する

segments.tr: 「硬化処理」とは：**

segments.src: - A) Letting soil dry and crust before planting
segments.tr: - A) 植栽前に土を乾かして地盤を形成させる

segments.src: - B) Selecting only the strongest seeds before sowing
segments.tr: - B) 播種前に最も丈夫な種だけを選別する

segments.tr: - C) 移植前に温室の苗を段階的に屋外の条件に慣らす

segments.tr: - D) 移植後に根の周りの土を固める

segments.src: O/X: A grower producing pumpkins for the Halloween decorative market should generally plant at a higher density than one growing pumpkins for canned filling.**
segments.tr: ○/×：ハロウィーン用装飾カボチャを生産する農家は、缶詰用カボチャを生産する農家よりも、一般的に密度を高く植えるべきである。**

segments.src: ## 📚 Today's Terms
segments.tr: ## 📚 本日の用語

segments.src: - **Direct seeding** — sowing seed straight into the field where the crop will grow to maturity, with no nursery stage.
segments.tr: - **直播き** — 種子を、作物が成熟まで育つ畑に直接播くこと。ナーセリー段階はありません。

segments.src: - **Transplanting** — moving a plant started elsewhere (greenhouse, nursery bed) into its final field position.
segments.tr: - **移植** — 別の場所（温室、ナーセリーベッド）で育てた植物を、最終的な畑の位置に移動させること。

segments.src: - **Nursery raising (seedling production)** — growing young plants under controlled conditions before field setting, to gain season length and uniformity.
segments.tr: - **ナーセリー育成（苗の生産）** — 生育期の延長と均一性を得るため、畑への定植前に管理された条件下で若い植物を育てること。

segments.src: - **Hardening off** — gradually acclimating protected seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and sun so they survive transplanting with less shock.
segments.tr: - **硬化処理** — 移植時の衝撃を最小限にするため、保護された苗を段階的に屋外の冷気、風、日光に慣らすこと。

segments.src: - **Planting density (plant population)** — the number of plants per unit area, usually stated as plants per acre.
segments.tr: - **植栽密度（植物集団）** — 単位面積あたりの植物数。通常は1エーカーあたりの株数で表示されます。

segments.src: - **Transplant shock** — the temporary growth setback a plant suffers from root disturbance and environmental change during transplanting.
segments.tr: - **移植時の生育遅延** — 移植時の根の傷つきと環境の急激な変化によって、植物が被る一時的な成長の低下。

segments.src: *Answers: **1 — B.** Yield per plant declines from the very first added competitor, because each plant gets a smaller share of light, water, and nutrients.
segments.tr: *答え：**1 — B。** 最初に追加した競合植物から、1株あたりの収量は低下します。各株が光、水、栄養を少なくシェアするようになるからです。

segments.src: Yield per acre is the curve that rises then falls; the two are often confused.
segments.tr: 単位面積あたりの収量は上昇してから低下する曲線で、この2つはしばしば混同されます。

segments.src: **2 — C.** Greenhouse seedlings are soft and unacclimated; a week of gradual outdoor exposure thickens cuticles and toughens tissue so the move doesn't set them back.
segments.tr: **2 — C。** 温室の苗は柔らかく、まだ屋外に適応していません。1週間の段階的な屋外露出により、植物の外皮が厚くなり組織が硬化するので、移植による悪影響が少なくなります。

segments.src: **3 — X (false).** It's the reverse.
segments.tr: **3 — ×（間違い）。** 実は逆です。

segments.src: Decorative pumpkins are sold by the unit and big fruit sells better, so they get more room per plant.
segments.tr: 装飾用カボチャは単位で売買され、大きい実の方が高く売れるため、株間をより広くします。

segments.src: Processing pumpkins are sold by weight to the cannery, where total tonnage per acre is all that matters, so they're planted more densely.*
segments.tr: 加工用カボチャは缶詰工場に重量で売られるため、単位面積あたりの総トン数が重要で、より密度高く植えられます。*

segments.tr: Es kostet weit mehr pro Pflanze, aber es bringt dir drei Dinge:

segments.src: 1. **Time.** The seedling grows in a warm greenhouse in March while the field is still frozen. When you set it out in May, it's already five weeks old. In a short-season state like Minnesota, that's the difference between harvesting and not.
segments.tr: 1. **Zeit.** Der Sämling wächst im warmen Gewächshaus im März, während das Feld noch gefroren ist. Wenn du ihn im Mai hinaussetzt, ist er bereits fünf Wochen alt. In einem Bundesstaat mit kurzer Vegetationsperiode wie Minnesota ist das der Unterschied zwischen Ernte und Nichternte.

segments.src: 2. **Uniformity.** You throw away the weak seedlings before they ever occupy field space. A direct-seeded field carries its runts all season.
segments.tr: 2. **Gleichmäßigkeit.** Du wirfst die schwachen Sämlinge weg, bevor sie jemals Feldfläche einnehmen. Ein direkt gesätes Feld trägt seine unterentwickelten Pflanzen die ganze Saison.

segments.src: 3. **A head start on weeds.** A four-week-old transplant shades out weed seedlings that a germinating direct-seeded crop would lose to.
segments.tr: 3. **Ein Vorsprung gegenüber Unkräutern.** Ein vier Wochen alter Sämling beschattet Unkrautsämlinge, die eine keimende direkt gesäte Ernte nicht überleben würde.

segments.src: The cost is **transplant shock** — roots get disturbed, the plant sulks for a few days.
segments.tr: Die Kosten sind **Umstiegsverletzung** — Wurzeln werden gestört, die Pflanze wächst für ein paar Tage langsamer.

segments.src: The standard fix is **hardening off**: a week or so of gradually exposing seedlings to outdoor cold, wind, and full sun so they toughen up before the move.
segments.tr: Die Standardreparatur ist **Abhärtung**: etwa eine Woche lang schrittweise Exposition von Sämlingen gegenüber Außenkälte, Wind und voller Sonne, damit sie vor dem Umzug abhärten.

segments.src: Then comes the third decision: **planting density** — how many plants per acre, and how they're arranged.
segments.tr: Dann kommt die dritte Entscheidung: **Pflanzendichte** — wie viele Pflanzen pro Hektar, und wie sie angeordnet sind.

segments.src: This is the one that surprises people.
segments.tr: Das ist die, die Leute überrascht.

segments.src: More plants does *not* mean more yield forever.
segments.tr: Mehr Pflanzen bedeuten *nicht* für immer höhere Erträge.

segments.src: As you crowd plants together:
segments.tr: Wenn du Pflanzen enger zusammen drängst:

segments.src: - **Yield per acre** rises, plateaus, and then falls (lodging, disease, shading).
segments.tr: - **Ertrag pro Hektar** steigt, stagniert und sinkt dann (Lager, Krankheit, Beschattung).

segments.src: - **Yield per individual plant** falls the whole way — steadily, from the very first added plant.
segments.tr: - **Ertrag pro einzelner Pflanze** sinkt die ganze Zeit — stetig, von der allerersten hinzugefügten Pflanze an.

segments.src: Which curve you optimize for depends on what you're selling.
segments.tr: Welche Kurve du optimierst, hängt davon ab, was du verkaufst.

segments.src: If you sell by the ton — corn silage, hay, processing tomatoes — push density high and don't care that each plant is smaller.
segments.tr: Wenn du nach Tonne verkaufst — Maissilage, Heu, Verarbeitungstomaten — drücke die Dichte hoch und kümmere dich nicht darum, dass jede Pflanze kleiner ist.

segments.src: If you sell by the unit and size matters — a head of cabbage, a jack-o'-lantern pumpkin, a table-grade apple — back off, because a field of undersized product is worth less than a field of fewer good ones.
segments.tr: Wenn du nach Einheit verkaufst und Größe wichtig ist — ein Kohlkopf, ein Kürbis zum Schnitzen, ein Tafelsortenapfel — gehe zurück, weil ein Feld untergroßer Produkte weniger wert ist als ein Feld mit weniger, aber besseren Produkten.

segments.src: The arrangement matters too, not just the count.
segments.tr: Die Anordnung ist auch wichtig, nicht nur die Anzahl.

segments.src: The same 30,000 plants per acre can sit in 30-inch rows or 15-inch rows.
segments.tr: Die gleichen 30.000 Pflanzen pro Hektar können in 30-Zoll-Reihen oder 15-Zoll-Reihen sitzen.

segments.src: Narrower rows spread plants into a more even, square-ish spacing, so each one competes less with its immediate neighbors and the canopy closes over the soil sooner — which shades out weeds and keeps moisture in.
segments.tr: Engere Reihen verteilen Pflanzen in ein gleichmäßigeres, quadratischeres Muster, so dass jede weniger mit ihren unmittelbaren Nachbarn konkurriert und das Kronendach früher über dem Boden schließt — was Unkräuter beschattet und Feuchtigkeit einschließt.

segments.src: That's a big part of why US corn row spacing narrowed over the last century, alongside breeding for plants that tolerate crowding.
segments.tr: Das ist ein großer Teil der Grund, warum die Reihenabstände beim US-Mais über das letzte Jahrhundert enger wurden, zusammen mit der Züchtung von Pflanzen, die Enge vertragen.

segments.src: Rough shape of the relationship, in plain text:
segments.tr: Grobe Form der Beziehung, in Klartext:

segments.src: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)
segments.tr: plants per acre = 43,560 / (row spacing in ft x in-row spacing in ft)

segments.src: So 30-inch rows (2.5 ft) with plants 7 inches apart in the row (0.583 ft) gives about 43,560 / 1.458 ≈ 29,900 plants per acre.
segments.tr: Also 30-Zoll-Reihen (2,5 ft) mit Pflanzen 7 Zoll auseinander in der Reihe (0,583 ft) ergibt etwa 43.560 / 1.458 ≈ 29.900 Pflanzen pro Hektar.

segments.src: ## In Everyday Life
segments.tr: ## Im Alltag

segments.src: Walk through a garden center in Ohio in late April and you're looking at the whole lesson on two tables.
segments.tr: Spazieren Sie Ende April durch ein Gartencenter in Ohio und Sie schauen auf die ganze Lektion auf zwei Tischen.

segments.src: On one table: seed packets.
segments.tr: Auf einem Tisch: Samenpakete.

segments.src: Beans, sweet corn, radishes, carrots — $2 to $4 a packet, dozens of seeds each.
segments.tr: Bohnen, Süßmais, Radieschen, Möhren — $2 bis $4 pro Paket, Dutzende von Samen pro Paket.

segments.src: These are the direct-seed crops.
segments.tr: Das sind die direkt gesäten Kulturen.

segments.src: The packet says "sow directly outdoors after last frost" because these plants either grow fast enough not to need a head start (radishes, 25 days) or hate having their roots disturbed (carrots, beans).
segments.tr: Das Paket sagt "Direktsaat im Freien nach dem letzten Frost", weil diese Pflanzen entweder schnell genug wachsen, um keinen Vorsprung zu brauchen (Radieschen, 25 Tage) oder hassen es, wenn ihre Wurzeln gestört werden (Möhren, Bohnen).

segments.src: On the other table: cell packs of tomato and pepper starts, $4 to $6 for a four-pack.
segments.tr: Auf dem anderen Tisch: Sechserpackungen von Tomaten- und Paprikasämlingen, $4 bis $6 für einen Viererpack.

segments.src: Nobody sells tomato seed packets to casual buyers with a straight face in Ohio, because a tomato seeded outdoors in May in Columbus won't ripen before the first fall frost.
segments.tr: Niemand verkauft Tomatensamen-Pakete an gelegentliche Käufer in Ohio mit gerader Miene, weil eine im Mai in Columbus im Freien gesäte Tomate nicht vor dem ersten Herbstfrost reif wird.

segments.src: Somebody already did the nursery-raising work in February in a heated greenhouse — that's what you're paying for, and it's why a single tomato plant costs more than an entire packet of bean seed.
segments.tr: Jemand hat bereits die Baumschulanzucht im Februar in einem beheizten Gewächshaus erledigt — das bezahlst du, und deshalb kostet eine einzelne Tomatenpflanze mehr als ein ganzes Paket Bohnensamen.

segments.src: Now the density part.
segments.tr: Jetzt zum Dichte-Teil.

segments.src: Flip over that tomato tag: "space 24-36 inches apart."
segments.tr: Drehe das Tomatenetikett um: "Abstand 24-36 Zoll auseinander."

segments.src: Most first-time gardeners ignore it and plant six tomatoes in a 4x4 raised bed, because the transplants look tiny and the bed looks empty.
segments.tr: Die meisten Anfängergärtner ignorieren es und pflanzen sechs Tomaten in ein 4x4-Hochbeet, weil die Sämlingen winzig aussehen und das Beet leer wirkt.

segments.src: By August they've got a tangled mat with poor air circulation, more disease, and small fruit — a personal-scale demonstration of the yield-per-plant curve.
segments.tr: Im August haben sie eine verwickelte Masse mit schlechter Luftzirkulation, mehr Krankheit und kleine Früchte — eine Demonstration der Ertrag-pro-Pflanze-Kurve im Privatgartenmaßstab.

segments.src: The commercial grower down the road faces the identical tradeoff, just with a spreadsheet: a processing tomato field headed for a cannery gets crowded hard, because the plant is selling by the ton.
segments.tr: Der kommerzielle Anbauer die Straße hinunter steht vor dem gleichen Kompromiss, nur mit einer Tabellenkalkulation: ein Verarbeitungstomatenbeet für eine Konservenfabrik wird hart gedrängt, weil die Pflanze nach Gewicht verkauft wird.

segments.src: A fresh-market field where big, blemish-free fruit brings a premium at the farmers market in Athens gets more room per plant.
segments.tr: Ein Frischmarktfeld, wo große, makellose Früchte einen Aufschlag auf dem Bauernmarkt in Athen erzielen, bekommt mehr Platz pro Pflanze.

segments.src: Same crop.
segments.tr: Die gleiche Ernte.

segments.src: Different market.
segments.tr: Anderer Markt.

segments.src: Different correct density.
segments.tr: Andere richtige Dichte.

segments.src: ## Three-Line Summary
segments.tr: ## Zusammenfassung in drei Zeilen

segments.src: 1. Direct seeding puts seed straight in the field — cheap and fast; transplanting raises seedlings in a controlled nursery first — expensive, but it buys season length, uniformity, and a weed head start.
segments.tr: 1. Direktsaat bringt Samen direkt ins Feld — billig und schnell; Verpflanzung züchtet Sämlinge zunächst in einer kontrollierten Baumschule — teuer, aber es bringt Vegetationsperiodenverlängerung, Gleichmäßigkeit und einen Unkraut-Vorsprung.

segments.src: 2. As planting density rises, yield per acre goes up then eventually down, while yield per individual plant declines the entire time — so the right density depends on whether your market pays by weight or by the size of each unit.
segments.tr: 2. Wenn die Pflanzendichte steigt, steigt der Ertrag pro Hektar dann ab, während der Ertrag pro einzelner Pflanze die ganze Zeit sinkt — so hängt die richtige Dichte davon ab, ob dein Markt nach Gewicht oder nach der Größe jeder Einheit zahlt.

segments.src: 3. Arrangement matters alongside count: narrower rows spread the same plant population more evenly, reducing crowding between neighbors and closing the canopy sooner.
segments.tr: 3. Die Anordnung ist neben der Anzahl wichtig: engere Reihen verteilen die gleiche Pflanzenpopulation gleichmäßiger, reduzieren Konkurrenzdruck zwischen Nachbarn und schließen das Kronendach früher.

segments.tr: ## ✅ Selbsttest

segments.tr: Wenn du die Pflanzendichte erhöhst, was passiert mit dem Ertrag pro einzelner Pflanze?**

segments.tr: - A) Es steigt, dann sinkt

segments.tr: "Abhärtung" bezieht sich auf:**

segments.src: - A) Letting soil dry and crust before planting
segments.tr: - A) Boden vor dem Pflanzen austrocknen und verkrusten lassen

segments.tr: - C) Schrittweise Exposition von Gewächshaus-Sämlingen gegenüber Außenbedingungen vor der Verpflanzung
